meta.note: Canonical registry of every public meeting GovAgenda has a record of. Confirmed entries come from the city's official meeting calendar or from a sourced agenda/minutes document. Entries with confirmed=false are PROJECTED from each body's regular cadence and are regenerated on every sync — they are labelled 'Expected' on the site and are replaced by the confirmed entry as soon as the city publishes it. Append-only for confirmed entries: prior records are never deleted, only enriched (minutes/video links, status changes).
